deterministic.calibration: Measured 2026-09-23 on 4 agy probe images (1376x768). The neon-brain image that failed the house rules has a lower-left mean of 38.2 but a p95 of 126, because its bright code text sits there. A mean-only gate would pass it, so both limits apply. Unrelated images are 21-34 dHash bits apart. Recalibrate after the first shadow runs, with images made using the treatment.

judged.step: image judge (vision), added after image.generate works
hard_fail: Any text, letters, numbers, logos or signage anywhere in the frame
Screens, UIs, robots, brains, glowing networks, circuit boards, holograms
Illustration, vector art, 3D render look, neon, lens flare

subject_match.question: Does the photo show the subject in the concept, with its named materials?

treatment.question: Low-key light from the upper right, warm near-black ground, muted colour, lower-left in shadow?

photographic.question: Does it read as a real editorial still-life photograph?

judged.selection: Among the candidates that pass every deterministic gate and every hard_fail check, pick the highest total judged score. If none pass, the run publishes nothing and keeps all candidates as evidence.
